events.title: Birding & Brews – Happy Hour Edition
events.description: Wind down your afternoon with birds, brews, and bayside views! Join us for a relaxed, guided birdwatching walk along the beautiful Bayshore Bikeway at South San Diego Bay. Then, wrap up the day with a complimentary craft beverage at Novo Brewing—perfect for happy hour with a conservation twist. What to Expect: Birdwatching Walk: Stroll the Bayshore Bikeway with expert guides to spot native and migratory birds in their natural habitat. Ecology & Conservation: Discover fascinating facts about the South Bay’s wildlife and ongoing efforts to protect our coastal ecosystems. Happy Hour Cheers: Finish your adventure with a refreshing drink at Novo Brewing, with non-alcoholic options available too—a great way to toast to community and conservation. Every Birding & Brews tour helps fund our education programs for South Bay youth—so you can enjoy your happy hour knowing you’re making a difference!
events.location: San Diego Bay Refuge, 501 Florence St, Imperial Beach, CA

events.title: Birding & Brews – Breakfast Edition
events.description: Be an Ocean Connector and start your day with birding and brews! Sip on smooth, nitro cold brew from Trident Coffee as you learn how their values of connection, community, and character align with our conservation mission. Then, head out on a guided walking tour along the Bayshore Bikeway at South San Diego Bay, equipped with binoculars and field guides. What to Expect: Coffee Tasting: Kick off the tour with a unique nitro cold brew tasting, crafted locally by Trident Coffee. Birdwatching Walk: Explore the Bayshore Bikeway with expert guides to spot native and migratory birds. Ecology & Conservation: Learn about local ecosystems and conservation efforts to protect our coastal wildlife. Best of all, every tour supports our education programs for South Bay youth!
events.location: San Diego Bay Refuge, 501 Florence St, Imperial Beach, CA

events.title: Wildlife Kayaking Eco Tour
events.description: Be an Ocean Connector and join us for a Wildlife Kayaking Eco Tour! Join us for a guided Wildlife Kayaking Eco Tour through the beautiful waterways of South San Diego Bay, ending in the restored Chula Vista Wetlands. This scenic, two-hour paddle offers a unique opportunity to explore coastal habitats while learning about the wildlife and conservation efforts that make South San Diego Bay so special. Along the way, you may spot osprey diving for fish, great blue herons and egrets wading in the shallows, nesting terns (April to September), and a variety of migrating birds (October to March). With a little luck, guests can even catch a glimpse of a Pacific green sea turtle cruising through the bay! This tour is welcoming to all skill levels and moves at a comfortable pace, with plenty of time to enjoy the surroundings. The route is about two hours long, and wind conditions can vary, adding a bit of adventure while still remaining accessible for beginners. What to Expect: Wildlife Viewing: Paddle through the waters, keeping an eye out for local wildlife, from native birds to coastal critters. Educational Insights: Our expert guides will provide fascinating information about the local ecosystems and conservation efforts. Chula Vista Wetlands: Paddle toward the restored wetlands, a vital area for wildlife and an important conservation success story. Come prepared for a fun and challenging adventure while experiencing the beauty of the Chula Vista Wetlands. Sign up for our next Wildlife Kayaking Eco Tour today! Best of all, every tour supports our education programs for South Bay youth! Find more information at www.oceanconnectors.org Group Discounts available on 6 or more tickets. Email eco-tours@oceanconnectors.org
events.location: Bayside Park, 999 Bayside Pkwy, Chula Vista
